characters.name: Velveteen Rabbit
characters.notes: Protagonist stuffed toy; becomes Real through the Boy's love then fully alive via Fairy

characters.name: The Boy
characters.notes: Child owner whose love makes the Rabbit Real; later has scarlet fever

characters.name: Skin Horse
characters.notes: Wise old nursery toy who explains what Real means; made Real long ago by Boy's Uncle

characters.name: Nana
characters.notes: Nursemaid who tidies toys and first puts Rabbit in Boy's bed

characters.name: Nursery Magic Fairy
characters.notes: Appears from tear-grown flower; turns worn loved toys into Real living creatures

characters.name: Wild rabbits
characters.notes: Living rabbits who reject then later accept the transformed Rabbit

characters.name: Doctor
characters.notes: Orders infected toys burned after Boy's scarlet fever

locations_mentioned: end of the garden behind the fowl-house
timeline: Boy's scarlet fever illness and recovery
night in the sack behind fowl-house
withheld_name_or_twist_rules: Do not introduce or name the Nursery Magic Fairy before beat B12 (tear and flower)
Do not show or confirm the Rabbit possesses real hind legs, brown fur, or independent movement before the Fairy's final kiss in B13
Do not let the Boy (or audience via Boy) definitively know the marked wild rabbit is his old Bunny; keep the final recognition as the Boy's private wondering only
Mechanical toys' superiority and Skin Horse's backstory may appear early; the magic of becoming Real must follow Skin Horse's explanation before any transformation

essential_beats.summary: Christmas morning: splendid new Velveteen Rabbit arrives in Boy's stocking and is briefly loved then forgotten amid other presents
essential_beats.source_evidence: Rabbit is fat and bunchy with thread whiskers and pink sateen ears; best of stocking gifts for two hours until aunts and uncles arrive

essential_beats.summary: Rabbit lives ignored in toy cupboard; mechanical toys and others snub him as commonplace sawdust; only Skin Horse is kind
essential_beats.source_evidence: Expensive and clockwork toys look down on him; model boat and wooden lion Timothy put on airs; Skin Horse alone is friendly

essential_beats.summary: Skin Horse teaches Rabbit what REAL means: it happens when a child truly loves you a long time; it can hurt and makes you shabby but lasting
essential_beats.source_evidence: Real is not buzzers or handles; takes time; hair loved off and eyes drop out but once Real you cannot be ugly to those who understand; Boy's Uncle made Skin Horse Real forever

essential_beats.summary: Nana cannot find china dog at bedtime and stuffs Rabbit into Boy's arms; Rabbit begins sleeping with Boy every night
essential_beats.source_evidence: Nana swoops to cupboard and says take your old Bunny; Rabbit endures tight hugs and pillow smothering then grows to love whispered games and tunnels

essential_beats.summary: Time passes in constant companionship; Rabbit's fur wears shabby, tail unsewn, nose pink rubbed off from kisses, yet he is happy
essential_beats.source_evidence: He never notices the wearing because he is so happy; Boy takes him everywhere

essential_beats.summary: Spring garden days of wheelbarrow rides and fairy huts; after being left out in dew Nana grumbles and Boy fiercely declares Bunny is REAL not a toy
essential_beats.source_evidence: Nana calls him a toy; Boy sits up and says you mustn't say that he isn't a toy he's REAL; Rabbit knows nursery magic has happened

essential_beats.summary: Summer wood evenings: Rabbit left in bracken nest meets two wild furry rabbits who invite play then mock his missing hind legs and wrong smell and flee
essential_beats.source_evidence: Wild rabbits change shape and hop; they laugh he has no hind legs and doesn't smell right so isn't real; Rabbit insists Boy said he is Real but they vanish

essential_beats.summary: Weeks more of hard love leave Rabbit very old and shapeless yet still beautiful only to the Boy; shabbiness no longer matters because he is Real
essential_beats.source_evidence: Whiskers loved off, ear lining grey, spots faded; to the Boy he is always beautiful

essential_beats.summary: Boy falls dangerously ill with fever; Rabbit stays hidden under bedclothes afraid of being taken away while strange people come and go
essential_beats.source_evidence: Boy's body burns the Rabbit; Rabbit never stirs because Boy needs him; plans future garden games while fever lasts

essential_beats.summary: Boy recovers and will go to seaside; doctor orders room disinfected and all bed toys including old Bunny burned as scarlet fever germs; Rabbit bagged with rubbish behind fowl-house
essential_beats.source_evidence: Doctor says burn it at once get him a new one; gardener will burn the lot next morning; Boy gets splendid new plush bunny but thinks only of seaside

essential_beats.summary: Alone and shivering in open sack Rabbit remembers happy days and Skin Horse wisdom; questions use of becoming Real if it ends thus; sheds a real tear
essential_beats.source_evidence: Great sadness; tear trickles down shabby velvet nose to the ground

essential_beats.summary: Where tear fell a mysterious emerald-leaved golden-cup flower grows and opens; lovely Nursery Magic Fairy steps out, kisses Rabbit, and explains she takes worn loved playthings and makes them Real to everyone
essential_beats.source_evidence: Fairy says he was Real to the Boy because of love; now he shall be Real to every one; she flies him into the moonlit wood

essential_beats.summary: Fairy sets Rabbit among dancing wild rabbits and tells them to teach him; after last kiss he discovers real hind legs and soft brown fur and joyfully leaps and whirls until Fairy is gone
essential_beats.source_evidence: He scratches nose with new hind toe then springs about; at last a Real Rabbit at home with the others

essential_beats.summary: Next Spring Boy playing in same wood sees two rabbits; one has faint spotted markings and familiar soft nose and eyes; Boy wonders if it is his old Bunny lost in the fever but never knows for certain
essential_beats.source_evidence: Boy thinks he looks just like my old Bunny that was lost; never knew it really was his own Bunny come back
